name: Zito's Pizza
tagline: Authentic hand-tossed NY-style pizza, lunch combos & late-night slices
description: An Old Towne Orange staple since 1999 on North Glassell Street, Zito's Pizza is celebrated for authentic New York-style hand-tossed thin crust pies, garlic knots, calzones, and hearty hot sub sandwiches. Frequented by Chapman University students and local families alike, Zito's offers daily $7.99 slice and sub lunch combos and late-night weekend pizza slices until 1:00 AM.
historicNote: Situated in a historic early 20th-century storefront with traditional checkered floor tiles, vintage sports memorabilia, and an open pizza prep counter.
